title: SORA and Compounded SORA, daily
description: The Singapore Overnight Rate Average for every business day since July 2005, with MAS's SORA Index, the 1, 3 and 6-month Compounded SORA, and, from August 2020, the volume and the highest and lowest rates traded.
question: What is SORA today, and how has it moved since 2005?

fields.name: value_date
fields.meaning: The business day the rate is for.

fields.name: publication_date
fields.meaning: The day MAS published it, usually the next business day.

fields.name: sora_pct
fields.meaning: SORA: the volume-weighted average rate of unsecured overnight interbank S$ lending that day.

fields.name: sora_index
fields.meaning: MAS's SORA Index, which compounds SORA day by day; the change between two dates gives the compounded rate between them.

fields.name: compounded_1m_pct
fields.meaning: 1-month Compounded SORA: SORA compounded over the month before the publication date (MAS's figure from 6 Aug 2020; ours, by MAS's method, before that).

fields.name: compounded_3m_pct
fields.meaning: 3-month Compounded SORA, worked out the same way over three months. Most SORA home loans use this one.

fields.name: compounded_6m_pct
fields.meaning: 6-month Compounded SORA, worked out the same way over six months.

fields.name: volume_sgd_m
fields.meaning: Total overnight lending SORA was worked out from that day.

fields.name: highest_rate_pct
fields.meaning: The highest rate among the trades that day.

fields.name: lowest_rate_pct
fields.meaning: The lowest rate among the trades that day.
